Yes, I expect everything to be private to me and still there when I return. The four flows you summarized are right, but I’m not ready to start implementation yet because several important behaviours haven’t been explored.

In particular:

- When entering tags, I want suggestions from tags I already use.
- I need to select several bookmarks—or every bookmark matching the current search or view—and add/remove tags, mark read/unread, archive, or delete them together.
- Notes should support simple Markdown formatting and display it properly.
- I want a preserved copy of a page that I can revisit if the original changes or disappears. For a PDF, preserve the PDF itself. I’d also like the option to save a copy through the Internet Archive.
- I want to save useful combinations of search text and included or excluded tags for reuse.
- I need to import existing browser bookmarks and export my collection in the standard bookmark HTML format, keeping titles, tags, and original saved dates.
- Display preferences should include text size as well as the sort and number shown.

Also, the real favicon and preview image aren’t merely optional polish to me; they are part of the page information I expect the app to collect automatically and show with each bookmark.

Please walk me through these remaining behaviours before building the final application.
